release_notes: Buy & Park on the Domains page is repaired end to end. Address Book contacts with ID 0 (the primary address on many accounts) are no longer dropped, and registration now resolves the selected contact through users.address.getInfo and submits the full four-role field set that Namecheap's domains.create actually requires — the old *AddressId shortcut answered 'Parameter RegistrantFirstName is Missing'; contact requests also move to form POST, keeping the API key out of the URL. Regular domains are quoted a real one-year registration price from users.getPricing (plus the ICANN fee) instead of a misleading $0 read off the premium-price field, premium domains keep their own price and fees, the currency shows in the dialog and confirmation, and a missing or malformed quote disables the purchase button with a 'price unavailable' notice. Three new regression suites cover pricing, contact resolution and the zero address ID.
